metadata.title: Gritty Urban Portrait with Stencil Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key monochrome portrait of a man positioned on the right, emerging from deep black negative space. The composition features a bold, blood-red stencil-style title with realistic spray-paint drips and a clean, minimalist subtitle centered below it.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting defining facial contours against a void
Vibrant red textured typography against a desaturated, dark background
Juxtaposition of raw, messy stencil art with clean, modern sans-serif type
Hand gesture in the lower right mirroring the verticality of the facial features
coreInvariants: Realistic paint drip textures on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is cropped tightly, occupying the right third of the frame, extending from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red display text in the center-left acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red text, move right to the illuminated face, then down to the hand gesture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of negative space on the left side to provide breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated silver/grey for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated crimson red for the primary title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between shadows and highlights; high saturation limited strictly to the display text.

letterConstructionRules: Visible spray-paint splatter and overspray effects
Vertical drips extending from the bottom of characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have varying levels of distress to mimic hand-stenciling

composition.relationshipToImage: centered horizontally relative to the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Raw, expressive display type paired with clinical, wide-tracked sans-serif for professional contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base slab-serif stencil structure.
Clean geometric base for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-key monochrome portrait of a man with blonde-streaked hair, looking down. Use chiaroscuro lighting so half the face is in deep shadow. Position him on the right side of a pure black 1:1 frame. Include a hand gesture in the lower right. Apply a subtle film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large crimson-red title in a distressed stencil font with realistic vertical paint drips. Below it, center a subtitle in a clean, white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Does the red text have visible drips?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough?

avoid: Default, clean fonts for the title

postGenerationChecks: Check for true black levels in shadows
Ensure red text is the most saturated element
Verify stencil bridges are present in the display type
Confirm the subject is off-center to the right
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key monochrome portrait + Asymmetrical negative space + Distressed red stencil type + Clean wide-tracked metadata.
